label: Inspired O2 Fraction
note: P12 stores a fraction (0.21-1.0); MIMIC-IV charts a percent and has no unit string (checked on the demo: 1,743 of 1,746 values are >= 21, median 40)

label: GCS - Total
note: d_items has no total-GCS item (only 220739, 223900, 223901 for the components); named after them

label: Bicarbonate
note: 1 mmol/L = 1 mEq/L for a monovalent ion

label: Invasive Ventilation
note: P12 does not tell invasive from non-invasive ventilation; the value is always 1

label: Magnesium
note: the P12 documentation says mmol/L but the values (median 2.0, p99 3.2) are mg/dL, the MIMIC-IV unit: no conversion

label: pCO2
note: MIMIC-IV writes the lab unit 'mm Hg' (with a space; the chart items use 'mmHg')

label: pO2
note: MIMIC-IV writes the lab unit 'mm Hg' (with a space; the chart items use 'mmHg')

label: Temperature Celsius
note: MIMIC-IV also has Temperature Fahrenheit (223761); the Celsius item is used

label: Troponin I
note: 1 ug/L = 1 ng/mL; no troponin I row in the MIMIC-IV demo, the unit is taken from the MIMIC-IV documentation

label: Foley
note: the main urine-output item of d_items (Category Output)
